name: Momentum Top-N
rationale: Concentrated bet on the strongest 12-month momentum names, rebalanced every two weeks, with profit-taking and a stop to limit reversals.

rebalance_triggers.condition: Breadth (share of stocks above 50d MA) below 35%
rebalance_triggers.action: Cut equity to the defensive level

risk_notes: High concentration; momentum crashes after sharp rebounds hurt.
